root_cause_hypothesis: The case spec asked for the display and edit methods to go in an AxTableExtension. An AxTableExtension document has no <Methods> element at all — no shipped table extension in ApplicationSuite has one — so on a table you do not own they must live in an [ExtensionOf(tableStr(...))] final class. Authored from documentation; the platform disagreed. Case instruction and target_artifact_types corrected, and the realization in the extension class builds clean and BP-clean.
